Downbound 1M page 008041 explicitly marks October 1 class=ok; searched 008042 is a different timing variant and is not bound as the selected train. Upbound 5004M is independently read in the weekday whole-line table, 201 columns including station/arrival headers, zero-based column 29, weekday operation and empty additional operation notes. Keep the contiguous Matsumoto-to-Shinjuku section; omit onward Tokyo without asserting full route. Search hit 063751 is weekend-only and not used as October 1 return. No inferred reverse, union of optional calls or neighbouring-column inheritance. Retain current minimum topology representation consistent with previous reviewed JR phases; no broad raw redistribution or paid public deep-link licence asserted.
